abilities.name: Armenian
abilities.effect: If a Group with the Armenian Ability fails a Morale Check and would be Broken as a result, it may immediately re-roll the test provided the Group has more models than Morale Penalties.

abilities.name: Byzantine
abilities.effect: Byzantine infantry may re-roll failed Order tests.

abilities.name: Devoted
abilities.effect: If a Group with the Devoted Ability is given an Order by an Outremer Lord or Baron or a Military Order Commander or Marshal, it may remove one Morale Penalty.

abilities.name: Embattled Land
abilities.effect: Any Group within Command Range may roll a Morale check during the Housekeeping phase (where eligible to remove Morale Dice). If successful, the Group reduces its Morale Penalties by 2 rather than 1.

abilities.name: Maronite Arab
abilities.effect: May re-roll all failed Ranged Attack Dice in a single Action once per game.

abilities.name: Shower Shooting
abilities.effect: If shooting with a Composite Bow while stationary, the Group may choose to re-roll all of its Attack dice (whether successful or not). The second result must be used.

abilities.name: Turcopole
abilities.effect: Groups of Turcopoles can only be used as a Command Group for a Mounted Turcopolier.

weapons.name: Composite Bow
weapons.effect: RANGED - 20" Long range, 6" Short range. MOVE AND SHOOT - Can move 3" and shoot at short range. RECURVE BOW - Targets wearing Mail suffer a -1 modifier to Defence rolls.
